AI Overview
Flagpie is a daily online geography and trivia game created by GeoTom where you identify a country from a pie chart showing the exact color proportions of its national flag. 
flagpie.net
 +1
How to Play
Analyze the Pie Chart: Look at the slice percentages for each color in the mystery flag. 
Make a Guess: Type a country name to submit your guess (you get 5 total guesses). 
Receive Hints: Each wrong guess unlocks extra clues about the target country's geography, population, or neighbors.

Ignore Tiny Colors: Any color making up less than 1% of the flag is typically excluded or noted separately.

Game Modes & Features
Daily Puzzle: A new country flag challenge drops every day on the Flagpie Website. 
Flagpie Draw: An optional mode where you try to draw a country's national flag from memory. 
Archives & Premium: Accessing past daily puzzles and deep statistics requires a premium subscription.
